description: This PHP class 'LocalizedDateFormatter' provides date formatting utilities with localization support, allowing conversion of DateTime objects into localized date strings based on various format characters. It includes caching for format replacements and leverages traits for text handling and internationalization.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting dates with localized day and month names, supporting multiple format options and caching.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a localized string based on a supplied date format string, replacing day/month tokens with localized names.

methods.name: getSearchAndReplaceParams
methods.description: Generates search and replace arrays for day/month tokens in the date format string, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortDays
methods.description: Adds short day names and their localized equivalents to search and replace arrays if short day format char is present.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongDays
methods.description: Adds long day names and their localized equivalents if long day format char is specified.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortMonth
methods.description: Adds short month names and their localized equivalents if short month format char is specified.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongMonth
methods.description: Adds long month names and their localized equivalents if long month format char is specified.
